name: Relative Strangers
source:
Have you ever been to a family reunion and thought "I wish this was worse"? If so, this game is for you!

Relative Strangers is a horror game for people with social anxiety. After your father dies you think things can’t get much worse, that is until a Stranger shows up at the will reading claiming to be you. What should be a simple correction is complicated by your family who are all too estranged to know for sure and too self absorbed to care. Quickly this banal event turns to a fight for your inheritance, your identity, and maybe even your life.

[From [url=https://rubyparasite.itch.io/relative-strangers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是否曾经参加过家庭聚会并想过“我希望情况更糟”？如果是这样，那么这款游戏适合你！

《相对的陌生人》是一款适合社交焦虑人群的恐怖游戏。当你的父亲去世后，你认为事情不会变得更糟，直到一个陌生人出现在遗嘱宣读处，自称是你。本来应该是简单的纠正却因为你的家人太疏远而无法确定，也太专注于照顾而变得复杂。很快，这个平庸的事件就变成了一场争夺你的遗产、你的身份，甚至可能是你的生命的战斗。

[来自[url=https://rubyparasite.itch.io/relative-strangers]Itch.io[/url]]
